name: 驾校学车
desc: 学车练车时和教练沟通的常用句，起步、靠边、变道、考试要点
descEn: Common phrases for talking with a driving instructor — starting, parking, lane changes, exam points
author: ZiTan 社区 / ZiTan Community

deaf.t: 我听不见，请看我手机屏幕
deaf.en: I'm deaf — please look at my phone

deaf.t: 请面对我说话，我可以看口型
deaf.en: Please face me, I can read lips

deaf.t: 教练，请写下来，我回家再练
deaf.en: Coach, please write it down so I can practice at home

deaf.t: 我已经准备好了，可以开始
这个动作我还没学会，能再教一次吗
deaf.en: I haven't got this yet — can you teach me again?

deaf.t: 请慢一点，我反应不过来
deaf.en: Slower please, I need time to react

deaf.t: 起步要做什么，请告诉我
deaf.en: What should I do to start moving?

deaf.t: 靠边停车，我要注意什么
deaf.en: What should I watch when pulling over?

deaf.t: 变道前要看什么，请指给我看
deaf.en: What do I check before changing lanes? Show me

deaf.t: 倒车入库我总是压线，问题在哪
deaf.en: I keep crossing the line when reversing — what's wrong?

deaf.t: 考试要注意哪些点，请写下来
deaf.en: Please write down the key exam points

vol.en: Don't be nervous, take it easy
Check both mirrors before moving off
Signal left, get ready to change lanes

vol.t: 看到前面那辆车吗，保持距离
vol.en: See that car ahead? Keep your distance
Straighten the wheel, release the clutch slowly
Stop here and apply the handbrake
